name: Kagami no Kuni no Himegimi
source:
Two girls with the same face, the same voice, the same height. Lizlotte, the princess of a small and poor country, was one of them. Then, one day, one of the princesses abruptly ran away from home. A few days earlier, she claimed to have been invited to a party in a neighboring country. The other princess decided to go to the party on her behalf.

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/ja/items/1654114]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩，有着相同的面容、相同的声音、相同的身高。贫穷小国的公主莉兹洛特，便是其中之一。某天，两位公主中的一人突然离家出走。几天前，她曾说自己受邀参加邻国的宴会。留下的另一位公主，决定代她赴宴。

[译自[url=https://booth.pm/ja/items/1654114]BOOTH[/url]]
